d: When Oliver, Diggle and Felicity disagree with Dinah, Curtis and Rene on how to handle Black Siren, the two teams face off and a fight ensues.
Oliver and Thea are shocked to hear that Roy Harper (Colton Haynes) is back in Star City. When they realize he's in trouble, they jump in to help him.
Nyssa Al Ghul (Katrina Law) returns to Star City to warn Thea that a group of renegade League of Assassins members are planning to attack her.
While Oliver and Diggle face their biggest challenge yet, Curtis is disappointed to learn that his new boyfriend has a firm anti-vigilante stance.
Feeling that he's failed at everything—being a father, a mayor, and a hero—Oliver lashes out at his family when he's visited by a ghost from his past.
Looking to expand his empire, Diaz and Laurel meet with The Quadrant, a coalition of mafia families who run organized crime.
While Oliver turns to an old friend to help battle Diaz, Rene returns from the hospital but has a hard time readjusting to life as Wild Dog.
A familiar face (guest star Colin Donnell) returns, and the pressure mounts for Oliver, who begins to wonder if he will lose everything in his battle to save Star City.
When Diaz targets Team Arrow and their loved ones, Oliver struggles with Felicity putting herself in danger when she gets the chance to stop Diaz for good.
With a new ally on his team, Oliver engages Diaz in an epic final battle in the sixth season finale.
In the season seven premiere, Oliver (Stephen Amell) tries to keep a low profile in prison when he runs into old foes. And Felicity focuses on William.
In order to track down Diaz from inside prison, Oliver has to align with an old enemy. And Felicity's attempts to find Diaz are thwarted by Diggle, who's now allegiant to ARGUS.
Still in prison, Oliver faces his biggest challenge yet. Meanwhile, Felicity gets an intriguing offer, and Diggle asks Curtis to go undercover for ARGUS.
When arsonists target Rene's community center and injure Zoe, the mysterious Green Arrow helps save the day. Dinah faces pressure to capture the vigilante.
Felicity discovers a secret about Oliver that shocks her. Meanwhile, Diggle and Curtis go undercover for ARGUS, while Dinah works with an unlikely ally.
While Felicity enlists help in her pursuit of Diaz and Laurel flexes her muscle as the DA, Slabside becomes even more dangerous after a guard is murdered.
Oliver makes a choice that will affect his entire life, as well as the lives of everyone he cares about.
